pictures.name: NJ1-Mecca-Night
pictures.prompt: Mecca long ago at night: a dark valley ringed by bare mountains, the Kaaba small and simple in the center under a sky thick with stars and a thin crescent moon. Deep blue and silver, utterly still. No people or human figures of any kind. No animals. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.prompt: Today: the stockroom behind a hardware store at lunchtime, shelves of paint cans and delivery crates. One warm work lamp. Quiet, dignified, ordinary. A modern scene painted in the same contemplative oil style.
